scope: Every race-day model leader, every evening model leader, both conditional shortlists, all seven watchlist runners, the Lucky31, manual cases and rejections, and Idaho Fire discussed separately.
authority: Published results and factual race-running comments; website tipping verdicts not used.
interpretation_notice: Observed runs are paraphrases of the reported race comments, not personal video review. Assessments are inferences; no diagnosis, pace sectional or inevitable counterfactual is claimed.
